fact: On 27 August 2026 the Council of Ministers adopted a draft decree creating the national digital cadastral data reference (ReCAD) and a unique parcel number as the common reference for all administrations, with a legal framework for sharing cadastral data, and a draft decree on the national digital criminal record system with electronic interconnection and interoperability with other information systems.
title: Communiqué du Conseil des Ministres du 27 Août 2026 (Communiqué n° 27/2026)
publisher: Conseil des Ministres, République Islamique de Mauritanie (published by Rapide Info)
